utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the 15th of June. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: We can hear you. Whose new car is that in the car park, then? Takes up most of the view.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with a resale value of about half a sandwich.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'd swap it for somewhere cooler. The heating in the portakabin's having a laugh. It's June.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: You've got your own little tropical climate in there.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Also, there's a birthday cake in the office. Just saying, before the early shift finishes it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's the most useful status update we've had all morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a cake allocation meeting. Finished stuff first, then the actual actions.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, so I already swapped the filter on the GT1 fuel valve yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, completed, not something still waiting on us.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. And I tested the line 1 TCU yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. Two bits of yesterday's noise out of the way.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same from me on the water booster. Already swapped the filter on the water booster yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Lovely. Those are completed updates, not new jobs.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I heard a slight rattle from the wrapper, by the way. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: So you're not raising a repair off that?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, no. Just saying what I heard. No job out of it at this point.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Similar one from me: heard a slight rattle from the IM2, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Okay, both observations only.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'm still blocked on the site water. Can't get to the site water until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no agreed window for that. It's not released work.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Same position here: can't get to the Injection Moulding Line 1 until production gives us a window. That stays blocked, not a new action for today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Oh, and we were going to replace the belt on the turbine one, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, that's off today's list as well. Onto what we are actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the boiler feed pump. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just so we're clear, it's the sign-off you're taking, rather than us bundling more work into that?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the boiler feed pump. I'll take that, and it comes first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood, Grace. That one's ahead of the rest for you.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Marcus, can you check the guarding on the Palletiser, tomorrow at 9:30? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll check the guarding on the Palletiser tomorrow at 9:30. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you there—guarding check, not a rebuild or anything?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's right, check the guarding. Tomorrow at 9:30, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And Marc, can you take vibration readings on the air compressor by the end of the week? Normal priority on that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take vibration readings on the air compressor by the end of the week. Normal priority, separate from the guarding.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Useful distinction. Otherwise everything ends up with the same red flag beside it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. The air compressor readings are normal priority; the Palletiser guarding is top priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're on mine, I'll run a function test on the Line 3 Chiller after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: A function test, yeah? Not just a glance at the display.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, a function test on the Line 3 Chiller. That's what I'm taking on.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks, Marc. After lunch, and top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Agreed. After lunch, top priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you run the monthly fire alarm test? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test. Understood, not an emergency, but it won't fall off my list.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: The word 'monthly' always makes it sound ages away, doesn't it? Then suddenly it's here again.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. Months are getting shorter. Payslip doesn't seem to arrive any faster, mind.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, I'll do the pre-use checks on the forklifts on Friday. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Grace, you've got the pre-use checks on the forklifts on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do those. Fairly important, but separate from the sign-off that needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Saz, if you've got a spare minute, can you sort the training records for the new starters by end of day?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters by end of day. I can take that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: A spare minute on a Monday. Rare engineering resource, that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. But yes, by end of day. I've accepted it, before anyone thinks that was me wriggling out.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sarah, can you go to Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds to pick up the replacement parts for the cooling tower by the 28th? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, I'll go to Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds to pick up the replacement parts for the cooling tower by the 28th. Normal priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the collection we're agreeing, not fitting the parts as well?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, just going to Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds to pick up the replacement parts for the cooling tower. No installation action being added.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll swap the filter on the air dryer on the 3rd. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, air dryer for that one? Not the filter you said you'd already done?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, the air dryer. I'll swap that filter on the 3rd; it's urgent. The GT1 fuel valve filter was yesterday and is already done.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Got you, Sarah. The air dryer is the new commitment, on the 3rd, urgent. Not reopening the finished one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Good, because all the filters were starting to merge into one in my head.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: All clear on what's agreed, what's finished and what's still blocked?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, clear from me. No mystery extras hiding in the chat, hopefully.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nothing else from me. The cake was information only, before that gets an owner.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I think the cake's already got several owners. They're just not declaring themselves.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone.
